g.text: THE VERTEX, ROOTS, FOCUS AND DIRECTRIX OF A PARABOLA FOLLOW FROM ITS THREE COEFFICIENTS, AND EVERY POINT ON THE CURVE IS EQUALLY FAR FROM FOCUS AND DIRECTRIX
